## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Surfers Paradise, Australia. It starts at Level 77, Q1 Building, 3003 Surfers Paradise Boulevard.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> The Gold Coast is already fabulous at ground level, but from the sky it's a whole different ball game. Located 77 floors above Surfers Paradise, SkyPoint Observation Deck is the best way to experience the city in one breathtaking panoramic view.

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €23.34. It was rated 4.5 out of 5 from 94 ratings and 47 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
